texts.preamble: Damodar Malkani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2015 Crr-1952-2015 (Damodar Malkani Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
texts.facts: Also heard on I.A. No. 16072/2015, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to applicant Damodar Malkani.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the matter. It is further submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant was enlarged on bail during trial and he never misused the [LEAKAGE_MASK] to him. There is no likelihood of coming up of this revision for final hearing in near future, hence, the sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail. Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent-State vehemently opposed the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to applicant.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the matter.
